components.name: Highlighter CTA

components.html: Pedir orçamento
components.css: .ds-cta{position:relative;isolation:isolate;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:.6em;min-height:56px;padding:.55em 1.05em .55em .9em;font-family:'Sofia Sans Condensed Variable','Sofia Sans Condensed',sans-serif;font-weight:780;font-size:1.5rem;line-height:1;color:#121417;text-decoration:none}.ds-cta::before,.ds-cta::after{content:'';position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:-1;clip-path:polygon(0.8% 14%, 18% 6%, 55% 9%, 99.2% 0%, 100% 38%, 98.6% 88%, 60% 93%, 22% 91%, 1.6% 100%, 0% 56%)}.ds-cta::before{background:#ffe11a}.ds-cta::after{background:repeating-linear-gradient(-45deg, rgb(18 20 23 / 0.2) 0 1px, transparent 1px 7px);opacity:0}.ds-cta:hover::after,.ds-cta:focus-visible::after{opacity:1}.ds-cta:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #0b84cf;outline-offset:3px}.ds-cta svg{width:1em;height:1em}

components.name: Outline Button

components.name: Ink Button
components.description: Inverse action: ink fill, white hatching on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-ink{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;min-height:48px;padding:.6em 1.05em;border:1px solid #121417;background:#121417;color:#fcfdfc;font-family:'Sofia Sans Variable','Sofia Sans',system-ui,sans-serif;font-weight:650;font-size:1rem;line-height:1.1;cursor:pointer;border-radius:0}.ds-btn-ink:hover{background-image:repeating-linear-gradient(-45deg, rgb(255 255 255 / .22) 0 1px, transparent 1px 7px)}.ds-btn-ink:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #0b84cf;outline-offset:3px}

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Square sheet field with an ink bottom edge; pen outline on focus.
components.css: .ds-field{display:grid;gap:.6rem;font-family:'Sofia Sans Variable','Sofia Sans',system-ui,sans-serif;font-weight:650;font-size:1.1rem;color:#121417}.ds-input{min-height:54px;padding:.75rem .9rem;border:1px solid rgb(18 20 23 / .34);border-bottom:1.5px solid #121417;border-radius:0;background:#fcfdfc;color:#121417;font:500 1.125rem/1.4 'Sofia Sans Variable',sans-serif}.ds-input::placeholder{color:#5f666e}.ds-input:focus{outline:2px solid #0b84cf;outline-offset:0;border-color:#0b84cf}

components.name: Choice Row
components.description: Ruled option row; hatch on hover, pen hatching and filled box when checked.
components.css: .ds-opt{position:relative;display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.6rem 1fr;align-items:center;gap:.9rem;min-height:58px;padding:.6rem .75rem .6rem .5rem;border-bottom:1px solid rgb(18 20 23 / .34);cursor:pointer;font-family:'Sofia Sans Variable','Sofia Sans',system-ui,sans-serif;font-size:1.1rem;color:#121417}.ds-opt input{position:absolute;opacity:0}.ds-box{width:1.6rem;height:1.6rem;border:1.5px solid #121417;display:grid;place-items:center;background:#fcfdfc}.ds-box svg{width:1.2rem;height:1.2rem;color:#fcfdfc;opacity:0}.ds-opt:hover{background-image:repeating-linear-gradient(-45deg, rgb(18 20 23 / 0.2) 0 1px, transparent 1px 7px)}.ds-opt:has(input:checked){background-image:repeating-linear-gradient(-45deg, rgb(11 132 207 / 0.38) 0 1px, transparent 1px 6px);font-weight:700}.ds-opt:has(input:checked) .ds-box{background:#0a669f;border-color:#0a669f}.ds-opt:has(input:checked) .ds-box svg{opacity:1}.ds-opt:has(input:focus-visible){outline:2px solid #0b84cf;outline-offset:2px}

narrative.overview:
The site is the document a serious Portuguese builder hands over: a mapa de quantidades. Services are numbered articles (1–6, sub-items 1.1…), works are plates in Anexo A (A.01–A.13), the company facts are a filled table, and the quote form writes its own A4 "Pedido de orçamento" sheet as the visitor types. Everything reads as paper, ink and pen: a cool sheet-white ground, 1px ink rules as the grammar, a blue pen for anything that is a number, a link or an active item.

Density is that of a working document, not a brochure: tight rows, tabular lining numerals everywhere, condensed display type set large. Colour is almost absent; state is drawn with 45° section hatching, the way cut elements are drawn on construction plans. The single loud mark is a hand-drawn yellow highlighter band, reserved for the primary action and the newest filled row on the quote sheet.

Motion is document motion only: table rules draw left to right once on first view (900ms, 55ms stagger, first 24 rules), annex plates open with a clip-path wipe (1100ms). Nothing else moves; reduced motion leaves everything in its final state.
keyCharacteristics: Ink rules (1px) as the structural grammar; no cards, no radius anywhere.
Every service, work and quote row carries a durable article code in blue pen.
Hatching, not tint, for hover, selected and current states.
One highlighter band per view: the primary action (or the newest quote row).
Photographs are annex plates with registration corner marks and a caption row.

rules.name: The Pen Rule
rules.body: Blue appears only where a pen would write: codes, numbers, links, the current item, focus. Never as a fill for panels or buttons.

rules.name: The One Highlighter Rule
rules.body: The yellow band marks exactly one thing per view: the primary action (echoed only by the quote cell of the mobile action bar), or the newest quote row. It is always the irregular marker polygon, never a clean rectangle.

rules.name: The Tabular Rule
rules.body: Tabular lining numerals are on for the whole world (`tnum`, `lnum`). Numbers must align down a column like a real quantity sheet.

rules.name: The Column Head Rule
rules.body: Uppercase tracked text exists only as the header row of a table. It never sits above a heading as a label.

rules.name: The Paper-Only Shadow Rule
rules.body: A shadow is allowed only on something that is a sheet of paper. Buttons, plates, nav and panels stay flat.

dos: Do give every service, work and quote row a durable code (1, 1.1, A.01) and use it as the anchor.
Do separate content with 1px rules; close totals with a 3px double ink rule.
Do draw hover, selected and current states with 45° hatching (ink, or pen for selected).
Do use pen-text (not the lighter pen) for any blue text.
Do keep tabular lining numerals on; set numbers in the condensed face.
Do keep all corners square, inputs included.
donts: Don't put the highlighter on more than one element per view (the mobile action bar's quote cell excepted), or draw it as a rectangle.
Don't use blue as a panel or button fill.
Don't add shadows to anything that is not a sheet of paper.
Don't introduce a serif or monospace face.
Don't set uppercase tracked labels above headings; uppercase is for table column heads only.
Don't animate anything beyond the rule draw, the plate wipe and the highlighter sweep.
